metadata.description: Opinionated, project-agnostic guidelines that tell coding agents how to refactor, develop and migrate code and operate a homelab, one plugin per action, one skill per stack.

plugins.name: refactor
plugins.description: Refactoring guidelines for coding agents, one skill per stack. Skills: refactor:dotnet (behavior-preserving C#/.NET refactoring with per-version packs for .NET 8-11 / C# 12-15), refactor:react (React/TypeScript refactoring).

plugins.name: develop
plugins.description: Development guidelines for coding agents writing new code, one skill per stack. Skills: develop:dotnet (new C#/.NET features and fixes with per-version packs for .NET 8-11 / C# 12-15), develop:react (new React/TypeScript components, hooks, and features).

plugins.name: migrate
plugins.description: Migration guidelines for coding agents, one skill per stack. Skills: migrate:dotnet (retarget C#/.NET solutions to a newer framework using the per-version packs for .NET 8-11 / C# 12-15, with behavior and contract checks).

plugins.name: homelab
plugins.description: Homelab operation guidelines for agents, one skill per area, reading lab facts from a private memory vault or inventory. Skills: homelab:services (Docker Compose, Portainer, Kubernetes, Helm, helmfile), homelab:network (DNS, reverse proxy, TLS, VPN, firewall, VLANs), homelab:media (media server, *arr stack, Home Assistant).
